description:
**"We are just living our own lives. There's no fixed answer to life."
Stories of people "having the time of your life".

A piece of cake of comfort to you, who survived a tiring and hard day today.**

Ji-Yeong, who quit her job and pursues her dream, Eun-Hye, who decided to break up after a long relationship, and Hye-Su, a working mother who is tired of work and childcare... This work, which depicts the clumsy lives of characters in their 30s, resembles us who are standing on the path of growth. As the author said, "When I was in my 20s, I thought my 30s would be a more wonderful and special life, but now that I'm 33, I'm still struggling and full of mistakes," We, who grow up and seek small pleasures, can sympathize and find comfort in this work.

(Source: Jaemijuui, translated)
